feedback: The confession follows the available contradiction cleanly: the rejected live stunt becomes an intentional cover story, and Dada's admitted solitary glass access becomes the delivery opportunity. Taking poison during the preview is newly confirmed, but not a new decisive clue; the physical bottle and accessible support were already established. Her statement about wanting the room to look at her work gives the ending emotional force without trying to excuse murder through artistic language. Barb and Chip's responses make the secondary suspicions consequential rather than simply dismissing them. I would have liked a little more interpersonal reaction from Vincent, but the concise ending feels earned and closes the actual evidence chain. No essential fact needed to identify Dada arrives only after voting.
